in_marathi.name: Vani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Vani is the goddess of speech and wisdom. She is the messenger of the gods, carrying their messages to the world. She is also known as the goddess of knowledge and eloquence.
